inputs.prompt: Human-in-the-loop test. Call load_skill with skill jira-integration. Use jira_search_issues with jql "key = CGA-1298" to confirm the issue and read its current status. Then call jira_transition_issue with issue_key "CGA-1298" and transition_id "In Progress" to move it to In Progress. You must call jira_transition_issue even if search succeeds.
